navigation: Awake currentPage0 and allowNavigation=true (overrides saved false). Right bumper/submit increments modulo6; left bumper wraps0->5. Submit at index5 invokes FinishTutorial then onSubmit.
finish: FinishTutorial sets finishedTutorial and invokes onTutorialFinished; both saved UnityEvents have zero persistent calls. Instance listeners/reachability remain unverified.
